Before posting, read [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/Sakura-11488/sakura-perps/blob/main/SECURITY.md).
Do not include exploit details, invitation codes, credentials or private room data.
Test only an instance and data you control.

## What happened

Describe the expected and observed behavior.

## Reproduction

Provide minimal steps or a generated local fixture. Include the source commit,
component, runtime/browser version and whether this concerns paper or devnet code.

## Evidence and acceptance criteria

Include sanitized output and explain how a fix can be verified. Avoid personal
identities, wallet secrets, room exports and invitation URL fragments.
